import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv', sep=';', 
                   names=['StichtagDat', 'StichtagDatJahr', 'StichtagDatMM', 'DatenstandCd', 'HID', 'AlterV10Cd', 
                          'AlterV10Lang', 'AlterV10Sort', 'SexCd', 'SexLang', 'SexSort', 'KreisCd', 'KreisLang', 
                          'KreisSort', 'QuarCd', 'QuarLang', 'QuarSort', 'Rasse1Text', 'Rasse2Text', 'Rassetyp1Cd', 
                          'Rassetyp1Lang', 'Rassetyp1Sort', 'Rassetyp2Cd', 'Rassetyp2Lang', 'Rassetyp2Sort', 
                          'GebHundDatJahr', 'AlterVHundCd', 'AlterVHundLang', 'AlterVHundSort', 'AlterVHundNum', 
                          'SexHundCd', 'SexHundLang', 'SexHundSort', 'HundefarbeText', 'AnzHunde'])

# Convert 'StichtagDat' to datetime
data['StichtagDat'] = pd.to_datetime(data['StichtagDat'])

# Create a bar chart to show the top 10 most common dog breeds
top_10_breeds = data['Rasse1Text'].value_counts().head(10)
plt.figure(figsize=(10,6))
sns.barplot(x=top_10_breeds.index, y=top_10_breeds.values, color='skyblue')
plt.xlabel('Dog Breed')
plt.ylabel('Frequency')
plt.title('Top 10 Most Common Dog Breeds in Zurich')
plt.xticks(rotation=90)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

# Create a histogram to show the age distribution of dogs
plt.figure(figsize=(8,6))
sns.histplot(data['AlterV10Sort'], bins=10, color='lightgreen')
plt.xlabel('Dog Age (years)')
plt.ylabel('Frequency')
plt.title('Age Distribution of Dogs in Zurich')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output_2.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

# Create a scatter plot to show the relationship between dog age and weight
plt.figure(figsize=(8,6))
sns.scatterplot(x='AlterV10Sort', y='AlterVHundNum', data=data, color='pink')
plt.xlabel('Dog Age (years)')
plt.ylabel('Dog Weight (kg)')
plt.title('Relationship between Dog Age and Weight')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output_3.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
